children.name: Required component fields
children.characters: Incident: INC-2026-PORT-KLANG-01, title, criticality, detected date=07 Oct 2026, status=AWAITING APPROVAL. Source: Port Klang, Pacific Coils, STCOIL-440V, originalETA=Oct11, revisedETA=Oct18, delayDays=7. ImpactChain: explicit directed source → Supplier → PO → Material → WO → Product → Customer → exposure links. DecisionMatrix: authoritative baseline/disruption scenario snapshots. Recommendation: supplier=EuroCoils, cost=$30,150, arrival=Oct13, avoided=$120,000, netBenefit=+$89,850, supplied explanation, confidence=92%. DecisionLifecycle: five completed analytical stages, approval active, execution and verification pending. ActivityFeed: supplied actor role and action text, no invented timestamps.

children.name: Event and action intents
children.characters: Incident selected from Planner banner or pegged entity. Causal node selection opens related entity drawer; click selected WO to Plant Operations. Review approval routes to executive comparison and C5 gate. Activity expansion requires underlying event payload. Static alternatives contain visual states only, no prototype wiring.

children.name: Permission gates
children.characters: Investigate and simulate allowed to authorized Planner. Approval requires VP Supply Chain, required decision note and confirmation. Recommendation confidence is explanatory only, never spend/execution permission. Keep execution blocked until approved and required backend validation resolves.

children.name: Shared component contracts
children.characters: TopBar: product identity, entity search input/results/state, incident alerts, authenticated role and user context; exact user identity not provided. Sidebar: current role route, selected incident and plant context. Search intent finds Incident, Material, Purchase Order or Work Order; alerts intent opens the shared incident. KpiCard: entity-scoped label, value and unit, never invented aggregates. StatusBadge: entity state and semantic severity. Button: action intent, permission eligibility, loading, disabled and error outcome. Missing authorization state disables mutations. These are structured editable frames for later native-component conversion.

children.name: API state handling
children.characters: Loading: retain geometry and context, block mutations. Empty: explain missing entity records, never present zeros as missing values. Error: preserve last successful data, label stale, provide retry. Required provenance fields unavailable from API display “Not provided”; never fabricate URLs, notes, identities or timestamps.

children.name: Authoritative data validation
children.characters: Inventory ledger PAB reaches zero Oct 12. Supplied scenario snapshots report baseline Oct 13 / disrupted Oct 08; five-day coverage and Oct 08 stop conflict. Expedite arrival Oct 13 and the supplied recommendation explanation require critical-production requirement reconciliation. Keep values separate; do not recalculate or execute on inconsistent dates. 500 affected units = order exposure; 100 shortage = quantity gap. Yield = 220 / (220 + 2), rounded to 99.1%. Approval at $30,150 exceeds $30,000 under C5. 92% confidence is not execution authorization.

children.name: Surface-specific notes
children.characters: Scenario output Oct08 stockout conflicts with Oct12 ledger zero balance; expedite Oct13 explanation must be reconciled with critical production requirement timestamp, not provided. Preserve exact supplied values and wording; do not silently recalculate.
